acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Wife treated as maid servant at in-laws' house, husband suspected her fidelity and sent her out with wearing apparel. She filed case under Sections 498-A and 506 IPC, Maintenance Case MC No.105 of 2021, and complaint under Section 12 Domestic Violence Act, 2005.

legal_principles.principle: The cardinal principle for exercise of power under Section 24 of CPC is that ends of justice would demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceedings.
legal_principles.held: The cardinal principle for exercise of power under Section 24 of CPC is that ends of justice would demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceedings.

legal_principles.principle: In matrimonial matters, wherever Courts are called upon to consider the plea of transfer, they have to take into consideration the economic soundness of both the parties, social strata of the spouses, their behavioural pattern, their standard of life prior to the marriage and subsequent to the marriage and the circumstances of both the parties in eking out their livelihood and under whose protective umbrella they are seeking their sustenance to live.

outcome.final_order: Petition allowed to withdraw FCOP No.53 of 2022 from Senior Civil Judge, Nalgonda and transfer it to Family Court, Ranga Reddy District at L.B. Nagar.
